note: Houston County TX (48225): the county publishes no zoning layer; its DETCOG-hosted GIS (Houston_County_GIS_Data) has ESN, precincts, municipal boundaries and no zoning. Texas counties generally do not zone. The largest city, Crockett, has its zoning districts in Appendix A (Municode) and a planning report, but no public GIS/ArcGIS zoning district layer was found; its city site was unreachable for checking a map service.
